evidence.notes: Type-token HttpCalloutMock registration works in local test context.
Other mock interfaces remain explicit UnsupportedFeature fences.

source.content: public class FixtureMockResponse implements HttpCalloutMock { public HttpResponse respond(HttpRequest req) { HttpResponse res = new HttpResponse(); res.setStatusCode(203); res.setBody('token'); return res; } }

@isTest private class TestSetMockTypeTokenFixtureTest { @isTest static void typeTokenMock() { Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, new FixtureMockResponse()); HttpRequest req = new HttpRequest(); req.setEndpoint('https://example.test'); req.setMethod('GET'); HttpResponse res = new Http().send(req); System.assertEquals(203, res.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('token', res.getBody()); } }
